title: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds

result.label: The planar Mumford–Shah regularity conjecture and local weak-L4 gradient bounds
result.statement: Resolves the interior regularity conjecture for reduced absolute planar Mumford–Shah minimizers with bounded fidelity data. Locally, the closed discontinuity set is a C^ 1, arc, a regular crack tip, or three arcs meeting at 120^ ; only finitely many global connected components meet any compact interior region.
